اعتقلا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَقَلَا (iʕtaqalā) /iʕ.ta.qa.laː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
# اُعْتُقِلَا (uʕtuqilā) /uʕ.tu.qi.laː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
# اِعْتَقِلَا (iʕtaqilā) /iʕ.ta.qi.laː/: second-person dual imperative of اِعْتَقَلَ (iʕtaqala)
